targets.recommended_evidence_quality_note: V3-EXQ-912 (v3_exq_912_uncensored_survival_fishtank_20260810T190239Z_v3, FAIL, claim_ids=[]) ran at 1 of the queued 2 seeds -- the driver's own --seeds argparse default ([0]) was never updated to match its own docstring's 2-seed design, and neither the queue entry nor the runner enforced the declared seed count. At n=60 (not the designed n=120), 4/60 segments (6.7%) ended health_depleted -- below the pre-registered MIN_UNCENSORED_DEATHS_TOTAL=10 threshold, hence FAIL, but a real and better-powered point estimate than 906b's own n=8-based 25%. Non-contributory to governance (claim_ids=[]); characterization data retained, not treated as a claim-layer weakens. Corrected re-run routed as V3-EXQ-912a.

recommended_substrate_queue_entry.title: Enforce queue-declared seed count into actual --seeds execution (validate_queue.py / experiment_runner.py)
recommended_substrate_queue_entry.implementation_hint: experiment_queue.json's "seeds": N field is consumed ONLY by experiment_runner.py's _run_axis_count for progress-bar/ETA denominators -- never translated into a --seeds CLI arg. A driver's own argparse default is the sole source of truth for how many seeds actually run, and validate_queue.py never cross-checks the declared count against either an explicit args --seeds list or the target script's own argparse default. Fix: either (a) have the runner synthesize --seeds 0..N-1 from the queue's seeds count when no explicit args are given, or (b) add a validate_queue.py check that a queue entry with "seeds": N>1 and no explicit --seeds in args, targeting a script whose own default has fewer than N entries, is flagged/blocked. V3-EXQ-912 hit this (queued seeds=2, ran seeds=[0]); sibling V3-EXQ-913 avoided it only because its author happened to set SEEDS_DEFAULT=[0,1] correctly.

failure_record_entry.metric: manifest seeds=[0] (n_seeds=1) despite queue entry declaring "seeds": 2; n_segments_total=60 not designed 120; n_uncensored_deaths_total=4 < MIN_UNCENSORED_DEATHS_TOTAL=10, driving the FAIL
failure_record_entry.target: queue-declared seed count matches actually-executed seed count for every multi-seed queue entry, either by runner enforcement or a validate_queue.py gate

learning_extracted: The queue's seeds:N field is documentation/estimation-only; a driver's own --seeds argparse default is the sole execution source of truth, and nothing cross-checks the two.
The corrected point estimate at n=60 (6.7% uncensored death rate) is itself informative and better-powered than the n=8 906b/906c priors, independent of the seed-count defect.
Death-timing pattern (segments 17,19,53,56 of 60) is suggestive of a bathtub-shaped mortality hazard but underpowered at n=4 to confirm.

targets.recommended_evidence_quality_note: V3-EXQ-913 (v3_exq_913_developmental_ecology_fishtank_20260810T213204Z_v3, PASS, claim_ids=[]) -- genuine, non-vacuous engagement of all three combined manipulations (layout continuity, microhabitat zone-weighted cues, sleep-vs-no-sleep ablation), with substantive zone-conditioned field-statistic and sleep-organizes-trajectories findings (the latter on a thinner-than-headline n; 1 of 5 'matched comparisons' is fully degenerate). The flagship within-life-development readout (declining benefit_rate) is confounded by resource-patch depletion (55/96 segments exhausted; the sole zero-exhaustion cell shows a flat trend, r=+0.016 vs -0.13 to -0.65 in the exhausted cells) and should NOT be cited as evidence of declining competence. Non-contributory to governance (claim_ids=[]); descriptive characterization only.
learning_extracted: Zone-weighted microhabitat placement leaves a real, perceptible trace in the ambient resource_field/hazard_field channels REE already senses -- not merely a boolean 'zone map exists' engagement flag.

The within-life-development readout is confounded by resource-patch depletion under this run's own resource_respawn_on_consume=False + layout-continuity design; the sole zero-exhaustion cell (seed1_no_sleep) shows a flat trend where the three exhausted cells show strong decline -- a clean natural control embedded in the run's own data.
The sleep-ablation 'matched comparisons obtained' count does not distinguish valid from degenerate/null pairings; a future driver in this family should report a matched_comparisons_valid count.
